title: Pure Wicked Gods
summary: Yako Tenma's Wicked Gods archetype unites the three Level 10 DARK Fiend counterparts to the Egyptian Gods from Yu-Gi-Oh! R: The Wicked Avatar (whose ATK/DEF are always 100 higher than the strongest monster on the field and locks the opponent out of Spells/Traps for 2 turns!), The Wicked Dreadroot (4000 ATK/DEF that halves the ATK/DEF of all other monsters on the field!), and The Wicked Eraser (which gains 1000 ATK per opponent's card and sends the entire field to the GY when destroyed!)! Because the Wicked Gods are DARK Fiend monsters that must be Normal Summoned/Set by Tributing 3 monsters, you assemble 3 Tributes effortlessly using Egyptian God Slime (which counts as 3 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of ANY monster!), Reactor Slime (which spawns 2 Slime Tokens), or Double Coston (which counts as 2 Tributes for a DARK monster) + The Monarchs Stormforth! Then cast Yako Tenma's signature Spell Divine Evolution on your Wicked God to grant it +1000 ATK, un-negatable effects, and force your opponent to send a monster they control to the GY whenever it declares an attack!

allow.Double Coston: Level 4 DARK Zombie (1700 ATK / 1650 DEF): 'This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a DARK monster'—so pairing Double Coston with The Monarchs Stormforth (tributing 1 of your opponent's monsters + Double Coston) immediately satisfies the 3-Tribute Normal Summon requirement for The Wicked Avatar, The Wicked Dreadroot, or The Wicked Eraser!
allow.The Monarchs Stormforth: Quick-Play Spell that lets you Tribute 1 monster your opponent controls for your Tribute Summon—combining with Double Coston (2 Tributes + 1 opponent's monster = 3 Tributes) or Reactor Slime's 2 Tokens to Tribute Summon a Wicked God!
allow.Metal Reflect Slime: Continuous Trap Monster Set from your Deck by Reactor Slime that summons itself as a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK / 3000 DEF, immediately transforming into Egyptian God Slime (which counts as 3 Tributes for any Wicked God!).

main: The Wicked Avatar

Signature Level 10 DARK Fiend Wicked God (? ATK / ? DEF): Must be Normal Summoned/Set by Tributing 3 monsters; if Normal Summoned, your opponent CANNOT activate Spell or Trap Cards until the end of their 2nd turn after this effect's activation; and this card's ATK and DEF are always equal to the highest ATK on the field + 100 (even through temporary ATK buffs!)!
The Wicked Dreadroot
Signature Level 10 DARK Fiend Wicked God (4000 ATK / 4000 DEF): Must be Normal Summoned/Set by Tributing 3 monsters; halves the ATK and DEF of ALL other monsters on the field!
The Wicked Eraser

Signature Level 10 DARK Fiend Wicked God (? ATK / ? DEF): Must be Normal Summoned/Set by Tributing 3 monsters; gains 1000 ATK/DEF for each card your opponent controls; during your Main Phase, you can destroy this card—and if this card is destroyed and sent to the GY, it SENDS (does not destroy!) all cards on the field to the GY!
Reactor Slime

Core 1-card 3-Tribute engine: during your Main Phase, Special Summons 2 'Slime Tokens' (putting 3 monsters on your field to Tribute Summon a Wicked God on the next turn, or immediately with Double Summon/Metal Reflect Slime!); and tributes itself during the Battle Phase to Set Metal Reflect Slime from your hand, Deck, or GY so it can be activated this turn!
Guardian Slime

Special Summons itself from your hand when you take battle or effect damage, and tributes itself on your turn to Special Summon Egyptian God Slime from your Extra Deck (which counts as 3 Tributes for any Wicked God!).
Double Coston

Level 4 DARK monster that counts as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a DARK monster (The Wicked Avatar, The Wicked Dreadroot, or The Wicked Eraser!)—so Double Coston + 1 opponent's monster via The Monarchs Stormforth equals all 3 Tributes!
Divine Evolution

Yako Tenma's signature Normal Spell for the Wicked Gods: its activation and effect CANNOT be negated; chooses 1 monster you control whose original Type is Divine-Beast OR whose original name is 'The Wicked Avatar', 'The Wicked Dreadroot', or 'The Wicked Eraser'—it gains 1000 ATK/DEF, its effect activations cannot be negated, AND when it declares an attack, you can make your opponent send 1 monster they control to the GY!
The Monarchs Stormforth
Lets you Tribute 1 monster your opponent controls alongside Double Coston (2 + 1 = 3 Tributes) or 2 Slime Tokens to Tribute Summon a Wicked God!
Mound of the Bound Creator

Field Spell: Level 10 or higher monsters on the field (Avatar, Dreadroot, Eraser, and Egyptian God Slime!) cannot be targeted or destroyed by card effects; and whenever a Level 10+ monster destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the GY, inflicts 1000 burn damage to your opponent!
Metal Reflect Slime
Set directly from your Deck by Reactor Slime; summons itself as a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK to immediately transform into Egyptian God Slime.
extra: Level 10 WATER Aqua Fusion boss (3000 ATK / 3000 DEF): Special Summoned from your Extra Deck by Tributing a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK (Guardian Slime or Metal Reflect Slime); cannot be destroyed by battle, protects your other monsters from attacks and targeting, and can be treated as 1 OR 3 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of ANY monster (including The Wicked Avatar, The Wicked Dreadroot, and The Wicked Eraser!)!
